items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-proper-push-pull-ph-etale at source lines 2059-2068: for f proper it upgrades the push-pull statement of Lemma lemma-push-pull-ph-etale to the identity a_Y^{-1} o f_{small,*} = f_{big,ph,*} o a_X^{-1} and to its derived form a_Y^{-1}(Rf_{small,*}K) = Rf_{big,ph,*}(a_X^{-1}K) for K in D^+(X_etale) with torsion cohomology sheaves. The author's proof at source lines 2070-2140 proves (1) by rewriting through epsilon_{Y,*}, the comparison lemma and the proper comparison of higher direct images, then proves (2) by a four-term chain of equalities (using the commutative diagram of the push-pull lemma, the composition of derived pushforwards, the descent lemma twice and the proper comparison), and finishes with an induction on the cohomological degree that uses a spectral-sequence vanishing supplied by the comparison lemma and the fact that epsilon_{Y,*} reflects isomorphisms because it is the identity on underlying presheaves. Four results of the same chapter are used and are retained as context so the whole argument is available inside the package; one cross-chapter result is declared as a tagged pointer.
